title: P0: Repeating view export silently overwrites local edits
detail: At 7d1fb578, repeating attn view export into its previous destination silently replaces local view edits. The CLI writes into an existing destination at cli/attn/src/commands/view/mod.rs:194 and :213, including the stale-edit recovery flow that tells agents to export again. The isolated real CLI/daemon test preserves a benign local edit, repeats export and observes data loss. A fresh reviewer independently confirmed the result. Refuse an overlapping destination before changing any files, tell the user where to export safely, and verify the existing edits remain readable.
